LlamaIndex

Connect approved knowledge to an assistant.

LOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Use LlamaIndex's data connectors, indexes, retrieval components, and workflows to build applications over your own information. MoreSpace can create document-search assistants, research workspaces, and structured extraction pipelines with source context preserved for review. We design access-aware retrieval and document refresh rules so an assistant sees the right collection and its answers can be checked against the underlying material.

Useful outputs

  • Searchable knowledge collections
  • Answer drafts with retrieved context
  • Ingestion and evaluation reports

Where we can apply it

  • Company documents → ingestion → scoped retrieval → reviewed knowledge assistant.
  • Client files → extraction pipeline → validation queue → structured workspace.
  • Support question → relevant passages → cited answer draft → escalation if unresolved.

Use case 3

Inputs we need

  • Approved documents and source metadata
  • User and collection access rules
  • A set of representative questions

Delivery sequence

  • Ingest the permitted sources and retain ownership, dates, and references.
  • Configure retrieval and model responses with access filters and evaluations.
  • Review weak answers and refresh sources as the knowledge changes.

Expert review points

  • Verify retrieved material belongs to the requesting user's permitted scope.
  • Check source support and freshness before consequential decisions.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

Signals we can make visible

  • Retrieval relevance
  • Source-supported answer rate
  • Document freshness
  • Reviewer acceptance rate
